figures.cap: circle with centre O and rectangle ABCD, angle AOB 100 degrees (NOT TO SCALE)

solutions.latex:
Find $AB$ using the cosine rule in $\triangle AOB$:
$$\begin{aligned} AB^2 &= 45^2 + 45^2 - 2\times 45\times 45\times\cos 100^\circ \\ &= 4753.275\ldots \\ AB &= 68.943\ldots \approx 68.9 \text{ m} \end{aligned}$$
Sector (reflex angle $360^\circ - 100^\circ = 260^\circ$):
$$\begin{aligned} A &= \dfrac{\theta}{360}\pi R^2 \\ &= \dfrac{260}{360}\times\pi\times 45^2 \\ &= 4594.579\ldots \text{ m}^2 \end{aligned}$$
Rectangle:
$$\begin{aligned} A &= lb \\ &= 68.943\ldots\times 30 \\ &= 2068.319\ldots \text{ m}^2 \end{aligned}$$
Triangle:
$$\begin{aligned} A &= \dfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C \\ &= \dfrac{1}{2}\times 45\times 45\times\sin 100^\circ \\ &= 997.117\ldots \text{ m}^2 \end{aligned}$$
Total area:
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Total} &= 4594.579 + 2068.319 + 997.117 \\ &= 7660.01\ldots \\ &\approx 7660 \text{ m}^2 \end{aligned}$$

figures.cap: triangle PQR with sides 166 m, 100 m, 80 m

parts.latex:
Find the area of triangle PQR, correct to the nearest square metre.

\exfigure{3296_q7d_1}

solutions.latex:
Use the cosine rule to find angle $R$:
$$166^2 = 100^2+80^2-2\times100\times80\cos R$$
$$\cos R = -0.69725,\qquad R = 134.206\ldots^\circ$$
Then the area formula:
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Area} &= \dfrac{1}{2}\times100\times80\times\sin 134.206\ldots^\circ \\ &= 2867.312\ldots \\ &\approx 2867 \text{ m}^2 \end{aligned}$$
criteria: Writes the cosine rule equation, or equivalent merit

meta.format_note: Source criterion noted no rounding mark for the area.
